items.what_text: Fulton has the largest peer gap of the entire assessment (-0.89) at Data Management — driven by the structural pattern that Reltio Data Cloud (MDM) and Databricks (analytics) are present and well-managed, but the activation layer that pushes governed data into business-process apps in real-time (FSC, SFMC, Service Cloud, Agentforce) is missing. Kelly Dearwester joined as CDAO in Feb 2026 with an explicit data-products mandate; ~3 months in, the mandate cannot scale without an activation CDP that complements Reltio. The Reltio Jan 2025 case study confirms 'plans to expand MDM capabilities to other domains' but the activation tier is undefined. items.so_what_text: Recommended move: Deploy Salesforce Shield + Privacy Center as SF-Org-Specific Security Layer (Splunk + ServiceNow Remain Enterprise SIEM/GRC) — addressable via salesforce [E-045].
items.title: Deploy Salesforce Shield + Privacy Center as SF-Org-Specific Security Layer (Splunk + ServiceNow Remain Enterprise SIEM/GRC)
items.what_text: Fulton was hit by the Overby-Seawell vendor breach (2022, $750K Sept 2023 settlement, 100,744 customers affected) [I-003], which the L1 caps capped at level 3.5. With Fulton accumulating sensitive data in Salesforce (FSC + nCino + SFMC + future Service Cloud + Data Cloud), the Salesforce-org itself becomes a high-value target. Splunk + ServiceNow provide enterprise SIEM and GRC, but neither natively monitors Salesforce platform events (login anomalies, field-level read access patterns, permission changes). Shield Field Audit Trail also addresses Section 1033 audit-trail requirements that come due April 2028. In Zennify's assessment Fourth-Party & Supply Chain Risk Monitoring scores 2.0 out of 5, versus a typical 3.0 at comparable institutions [E-043].
items.why_text: At 2.0 out of 5, Fourth-Party & Supply Chain Risk Monitoring sits 1.0 points below the 3.0 typically seen at comparable institutions — a developing capability still short of the peer standard. Closing that distance would strengthen the data and technology foundation the rest of the business is built on, so progress here compounds across the rest of the business [E-031, E-043].

items.so_what_text: Recommended move: Deploy Agentforce for Real-Time Fraud Triage + CrowdStrike Falcon Shield Integration for AI-Agent Monitoring [E-043].
items.title: Deploy Agentforce for Real-Time Fraud Triage + CrowdStrike Falcon Shield Integration for AI-Agent Monitoring
items.what_text: Fulton experienced the April 2024 vendor outage (FIS Signature core) [I-004] capping at level 4. Operational risk monitoring relies on Splunk SIEM (enterprise) + ServiceNow + manual fraud triage workflows. The expansion to Republic First (closed) + Blue Foundry (summer 2026) materially scales transaction volume, but no AI-driven fraud-triage capacity has been deployed. The CrowdStrike + Salesforce Falcon Shield partnership announced Sept 2025 specifically integrates Charlotte AI into Slack via Agentforce for security — a deployment pattern that addresses both fraud (transactional) and SaaS security (operational) on the same platform. In Zennify's assessment Loss Data Collection scores 1.5 out of 5, versus a typical 3.0 at comparable institutions [E-007].
items.why_text: The assessment found: “11 director nominees for 2026 board year; Board determined 9 of 11 independent under Nasdaq + SEC rules (independence majority maintained at 82%)” [E-018]. At 1.5 out of 5, Loss Data Collection sits 1.5 points below the 3.0 typically seen at comparable institutions — an early-stage capability with the widest distance to close. Closing that distance would strengthen the core processes that keep the institution running, so progress here compounds across the rest of the business.
